adjudication_rows.title: Faithfulness-QA: Evaluating Long-Context Large Language Models Through Counterfactual Contexts
adjudication_rows.boundary_language: Position counterfactual-context faithfulness as adjacent to entity/state confusion, while keeping hard-grounded novelty limited to multi-source research evidence and conclusion-support failures.
reviewer_questions: Does Faithfulness-QA test document-state or entity confusion in a way that covers stale-vs-current and entity-disambiguation categories?
Does its metric evaluate answer-level conclusion support, or context-faithfulness under counterfactual substitution?

adjudication_rows.title: FaithEval: Can Your Language Model Stay Faithful to Context, Even If Context Is Noisy?
adjudication_rows.boundary_language: Cite noisy-context faithfulness work and reserve novelty for the combined evidence sufficiency, source authority, and citation-overreach taxonomy.
reviewer_questions: Does FaithEval include abstention or insufficiency scoring that overlaps the evidence-insufficiency category?
Does noisy-context faithfulness cover citation-support-overreach, or only context-grounded answer faithfulness?

adjudication_rows.title: Context-DPO: Aligning Language Models for Context-Faithfulness
adjudication_rows.boundary_language: Cite context-faithfulness alignment work and avoid claiming novelty for generic hallucination control in QA.
reviewer_questions: Does Context-DPO include benchmark tasks or only alignment data/methods for context faithfulness?
Does it require source-level citation support or only context-consistent generation?

adjudication_rows.title: LegalBench-RAG: A Benchmark for Retrieval-Augmented Generation in the Legal Domain
adjudication_rows.boundary_language: Cite LegalBench-RAG as domain-specific legal RAG unless its source structure directly tests authority hierarchy or cross-document contradiction.
reviewer_questions: Does LegalBench-RAG encode legal source authority conflicts or only legal retrieval/answering?
Does its evaluation separate citation support for facts from support for conclusions?

adjudication_rows.title: Benchmarking Fine-Grained RAG: Granular Assessment and Error Analysis in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
adjudication_rows.boundary_language: Remove any generic fine-grained RAG benchmarking novelty claim; limit novelty to the hard-grounded research-QA construct and review/gold workflow.
reviewer_questions: Does the fine-grained RAG taxonomy subsume any hard-grounded categories?
Which error-analysis claims must cite this work before submission?

adjudication_rows.title: GRACE: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Contextual Reasoning in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
adjudication_rows.boundary_language: Compare GRACE against the multi-hop, contradiction, and temporal categories before claiming hard-grounded reasoning coverage.
reviewer_questions: Does GRACE directly cover temporal/as-of-date reasoning or cross-document contradiction?
Does it evaluate large-corpus research QA evidence sufficiency and source authority, or contextual reasoning in RAG more broadly?
